Psychology glossary

Stereotype

A generalised belief about the characteristics of a group's members. It simplifies the world but leads to judging people by their group rather than as individuals. When it comes with a negative attitude it is called prejudice.

  • Prejudice
  • Social identity
  • Halo effect
